terms.definitionEn: A runtime failure signal that interrupts normal control flow unless handled.
terms.definitionAr: إشارة فشل وقت التشغيل بتوقف المسار الطبيعي لو ما اتعالجتش.

terms.definitionEn: A clause that marks statements whose thrown failures may be handled by a matching handler.
terms.definitionAr: جزء بيحدد تعليمات ممكن يحصل فيها خطأ ويتعالج في جزء مخصص.

terms.definitionEn: A clause that receives a failure thrown while its associated protected statements execute.
terms.definitionAr: جزء بيستقبل الخطأ اللي حصل أثناء تنفيذ التعليمات المحمية.

terms.definitionEn: A clause that runs after a protected operation whether it completes normally or abruptly.
terms.definitionAr: جزء بيتنفذ بعد العملية سواء خلصت طبيعي أو حصل فيها خطأ.

terms.definitionEn: A statement that raises a value and transfers control to a handler or caller.
terms.definitionAr: تعليمة بتطلع قيمة كخطأ وتنقل التحكم لمعالج أو للكود اللي نادى.

terms.definitionEn: A built-in constructor for values that carry a failure message and stack information.
terms.definitionAr: منشئ جاهز لقيم بتحتوي رسالة الخطأ ومعلومات عن مكان حدوثه.

terms.definitionEn: A built-in failure type used when source text or parsed data has invalid syntax.
terms.definitionAr: نوع خطأ جاهز بيظهر لما كتابة الكود أو البيانات المقروءة تكون بصيغة غير صحيحة.

terms.definitionEn: A built-in failure type used when an operation is not valid for a value's kind.
terms.definitionAr: نوع خطأ جاهز بيظهر لما نعمل عملية مش مناسبة لنوع القيمة.

terms.definitionEn: A built-in function that converts JSON text into a JavaScript value.
terms.definitionAr: دالة جاهزة بتحوّل نص JSON لقيمة يقدر JavaScript يتعامل معاها.

terms.definitionEn: A built-in function that converts supported JavaScript data into JSON text.
terms.definitionAr: دالة جاهزة بتحوّل بيانات JavaScript المدعومة لنص JSON.

terms.definitionEn: The conversion of structured data into a text form suitable for storage or transfer.
terms.definitionAr: تحويل بيانات منظمة لصيغة نصية مناسبة للتخزين أو الإرسال.

terms.definitionEn: A function or list of keys used to control which values JSON text conversion includes.
terms.definitionAr: دالة أو قائمة مفاتيح بتحدد أنهي قيم تدخل في نص JSON الناتج.

options: A syntax tree string that preserves the JSON source text rather than creating JavaScript values
A JavaScript object with ready set to true
questions.explanation: JSON.parse converts valid JSON text into its corresponding JavaScript value.

questions.question: When should code catch an exception, and what is finally used for?
keyPoints: Catch failures the current layer can handle meaningfully
finally runs after success or failure
Use finally for cleanup that must occur
questions.modelAnswer: Catch an exception when the current layer can recover, add useful context, or convert it into a documented result; otherwise let it propagate. finally is useful for cleanup that should happen whether the protected work succeeds or fails.

questions.question: Why can JSON.parse throw, and how should untrusted JSON text be handled?
keyPoints: Use try/catch at an appropriate boundary
Validate the parsed shape as well as syntax
questions.modelAnswer: JSON.parse throws a SyntaxError when the input is not valid JSON. Handle that failure at a boundary where a fallback or useful error can be provided, and validate the parsed value's shape because valid JSON may still have unexpected data.

questions.question: What data-shape limitations should be considered when using JSON.stringify?
keyPoints: JSON supports a limited set of data types
Circular references cannot be represented directly
questions.modelAnswer: JSON represents a limited data model, so functions and undefined values do not serialize as ordinary values, and circular references cause serialization to fail. Undefined object properties are omitted, while undefined array entries are represented as null.
